decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.0%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral day — existing 7 positions remain untouched and let their stop-loss/profit targets work automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices traded essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 roughly unchanged. No dominant catalyst drove the tape, consistent with a low-conviction, wait-and-see session ahead of upcoming data. Absent a clear directional signal, staying disciplined on entries mattered more than chasing action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現持平，納斯達克指數下跌0.2%，標普500指數幾乎沒有變動。市場缺乏明顯的主導消息面，呈現觀望格局，投資者似乎在等待後續數據公佈。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下，保持紀律、不強行進場比追高更為重要。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash uninvested and ready, rather than deploying it just because a slot is open. On a neutral day with cash below the deployment threshold, holding that cash preserves flexibility to strike when a genuine high-conviction setup appears.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留現金、暫不投資，而不是因為有空餘倉位就勉強買入。在市況中性、現金未達部署門檻的日子，保留現金能讓投資者在真正出現高信心的入市機會時，有足夠彈性把握時機。
